subject: Round 7: Verification and Discharge of Open Items (chr6 HPRC PAF Scoring, External Baselines, Progressive HAL, Bibliography, and Formatting)

claims.summary: Suite code formatting, clippy cleanliness, unified 11-subcommand horizon dispatcher (including filter and locus), aa5_keys DAG translated fallback test, horizon_clean 10M L-overlap W-split test, and 122 active Rust unit tests (88 lib + 34 bin + 1 HORIZON_TEST_HAL verified against halTest.hal) pass on 5cb83fb.

source.quote: All `122` active Rust unit tests (`88` library + `34` binary, plus `1` `#[ignore]`d `.hal` integration test verified against an external `55 KB` `tools-iuc` `halTest.hal` via `HORIZON_TEST_HAL`; `123` total) pass on `HEAD` with zero `clippy` warnings.

claims.summary: horizon_filter --net achieves 99.12% exact recall and 99.65% conditioned / 99.32% unconditional exact precision against 2D HPRC chr6 1-to-1 truth (565 seq-free / 553 SDUST+MDL records), and tracked scripts benchmark 10k-200k HPRC subgraphs (horizon vs gfatools/odgi/vg) and 5 Mbp chr6 WGA (horizon_wga vs FastGA/minimap2; LASTZ timed out at 15s).

source.quote: `553` post-netting records (`436` pre-netting filtered by MDL; removes `12` p-arm `< 46 Mbp` records outside q-arm `1-to-1` truth while preserving `100%` of exact `109,119,624` bp coordinates: **99.12%** exact recall, **99.65%** cond. / **99.32%** uncond. exact precision; `SweepGA`/`KegAlign` unbenchmarked on host)

claims.summary: Dynamic finite-sample Conformal Risk Control (n_cal = 15, alpha = 0.07) and adaptive gap-bit penalties (estimate_hmm_params) are wired in src/mdl/mod.rs, and the multi-seed random-GC null sweep (18%/30%/45% GC, 10 kb) yields median=0 false-positive pairs across 6 seeds on 5cb83fb.

source.quote: Using online GC-conditioned Conformal Risk Control at risk level `α = 0.07` (`calibrate_null_crc_for_gc` over `n_cal = 15` synthetic `64`-bp decoy windows in `src/mdl/mod.rs`; Angelopoulos et al. 2024), Horizon enforces a finite-sample bit-savings floor floored by `max(10.0, 0.55 * log2(N * M))` bits (`min_delta_bits = 10.0`, while `horizon_filter` applies the `0.55 * log2(N * M)` / `10.0`-bit floor without decoy calibration) and a minimum column posterior floor (`0.15`).

claims.summary: horizon_guide --progressive --hal emits a progressive ancestral-node multi-contig HDF5 v0 HAL (from_multi_contig_progressive_blocks) including sister/consensus-rescued blocks, and verify_merge_guide_maf.py verifies 5-mammal UCSC chrM.maf recall/precision (95.5%/99.8% panTro4, 89.2%/97.1% rheMac3, 71.8%/97.5% mm10, 74.1%/98.2% canFam3).

source.quote: and on 5-mammal UCSC `chrM.maf` (`verify_merge_guide_maf.py`, `0.258 s`) emitted a progressive ancestral-node HDF5 `v0` HAL (`((((hg38,panTro4)Anc0,rheMac3)Anc1,mm10)Anc2,canFam3)Anc3;`, `2,103` bottom segments; `Anc0..Anc3` clone `hg38` on a CLI-order pectinate tree) with `95.5%/99.8%` (`panTro4`), `89.2%/97.1%` (`rheMac3`), `71.8%/97.5%` (`mm10`), and `74.1%/98.2%` (`canFam3`) pairwise `hg38`-projected MAF recall/precision.

claims.summary: All 9 held-catalog references plus Jukes & Cantor (1969) are synced into manuscript/references.bib and cited in manuscript/horizon_paper.md, with manuscript/horizon_paper.pdf rebuilt cleanly.
